title: KICK SYNTH -- layered kick drum synthesizer

sections.heading: USING IT
lines: Turn audio on with the speaker button, then hit TRIGGER or play any MIDI note.
Preset menu: Default, 808, 909, Techno or Trap recall pattr slots 1-5.
BODY: a sine that sweeps from Start Hz down to End Hz over P.Decay ms.
A.Decay sets its length; P.Curve and A.Curve bend the two envelopes; Level sets its mix.
SUB: a steady sine for low end -- Level and Decay ms.
NOISE and CLICK: short attack bursts, each with Level, Decay ms and Tone Hz.
MASTER: Drive (saturation), HP Hz, Lo and Mid EQ bands, limiter Ceiling dB and Release ms.
PITCH ENVELOPE and AMP ENVELOPE redraw the body's curves as you edit.
Slot + Load recalls a slot; Save stores the current sound there; Write saves presets to disk.
OUTPUT: fader for level, plus scope, spectrum and level meter.

sections.heading: HOW IT WORKS
lines: Each trigger fires click~ into a gen~ that restarts body, sub, noise and click layers together.
A second gen~ applies drive, high-pass, two EQ bands and a limiter.
pattrstorage kicksynth keeps every setting; slots live in kicksynth.json beside the patch.
